content: WATCH “Narayanamma” Song from the Telugu Movie Aadarsha Kutumbam – #AK47 exclusively on Aditya Music. #AadarshaKutumbam Grand Release Worldwide in theatres on OCT 9th, 2026! #AadarshaKutumbamHouseNo47 – #AK47 is an upcoming Telugu feature film starring Victory Venkatesh Daggubati, Srinidhi Shetty, Nara Rohith, Nivetha Pethuraj, Yuvina Parthavi, Raja Prajwal and an ensemble cast. Written and Directed by Trivikram Srinivas, the film features music composed by S. Thaman, cinematography by Ravi K. Chandran, and editing by Navin Nooli. Produced by S. Radha Krishna (Chinababu) under Haarika & Hassine Creations banner.
